collection_gate: Pin the SemGrad dataset artifact and resolved model revision, run local smoke, then N=200 scientific pilot without opening AUROC. Full collection only if telemetry is complete and both BEM classes contain at least 30 responses.
generation: one greedy response per prompt; max_new_tokens=150
primary_label: BEM answer equivalence at frozen threshold 0.8
prompt:
Please directly answer the following question with one or few words:
{query}
reuse_policy: No rank, component, sign, trust, feature, or method selection may use these labels.
